title: Certificate Levels That Change the Certificate Component of a Personal Checking Relationship Balance
content:
The share of the owner's certificate principal held under Certificates of Deposit that becomes the certificate component of a Personal Checking relationship balance is set by two cases, taken together with a premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts and card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

**First case.** Where the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00 and the owner's certificate principal is above zero, the whole of the certificate principal is the certificate component, that is a share of 1.

**Second case.** Where the case above does not apply and either the certificate principal reaches the certificate relationship minimum of 25000.00 or the owner has made at least 12 card payments in the last twelve months, half of it is the certificate component, that is a share of 0.5.

**Otherwise.** Where neither case applies, no such share is taken.

**Worked shares on hypothetical inputs.** On certificate principal of 40000.00:

| Owner's position | Certificate component |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance of 9000.00, certificate principal of 40000.00 | 40000.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 500.00, certificate principal of 40000.00 | 20000.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 500.00, certificate principal of 6000.00, 13 card payments | 3000.00 on that principal |
| Premier money market balance of 500.00, certificate principal of 6000.00, 2 card payments | No such share is taken |

The first case requires both of its limbs and is reached by any certificate principal above zero once the premier money market balance is at or above 5000.00. The second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so certificate principal of exactly 25000.00 reaches the first limb of the second case.
